subtopics.title: India's Performance
subtopics.summary: India retained its 131st position among 145 countries, with an overall gender parity score of 64.5%. Its dimension scores are 96.6% in educational attainment, 95.6% in health and survival, 41.2% in economic participation and opportunity, and 24.5% in political empowerment. Women hold only 5.9% of ministers and 13.1% of senior leadership and managerial positions. The booklet notes that progress in education and health has not yet carried over to the economic and political dimensions.
facts: India's rank: 131st of 145 countries, retaining its position
Overall gender parity score 64.5%, against a global average of 69.2%
Educational attainment: 96.6% parity
Health and survival: 95.6% parity
Economic participation and opportunity: 41.2%
Political empowerment: 24.5%
Women are 5.9% of ministers, compared with a peak of 30% in 2019
Women are 13.6% (74) of the 18th Lok Sabha in 2024, down from 14.4% in 2019
Women occupy 13.1% of senior leadership and managerial positions
Only 17% of CEOs and 20% of board members in Indian corporates are women

subtopics.title: Barriers and Government Initiatives
subtopics.summary: Women spend nearly five hours a day on unpaid household chores, three times more than men, and this unpaid work is valued at 22.7 lakh crore or 7.5% of GDP. Labour market, workplace safety and childcare issues continue to hinder women's participation. The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam mandates 33% representation for women in legislatures. Schemes such as Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, PM Matru Vandana Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana support girls' education, maternal health and financial access.
facts: Women spend nearly 5 hours daily on unpaid household chores, three times more than men
Unpaid work is valued at 22.7 lakh crore, or 7.5% of GDP
Most women are in informal, low-paid roles despite rising participation
Workplace safety concerns and inadequate childcare are major hurdles
40% of girls aged 15-18 are not in school
Female labour participation grew from 23.3% (2017-18) to 41.7% (2023-24)
Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (106th Constitutional Amendment, 2023) mandates 33% representation for women in legislatures
Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (2015) targets the falling child sex ratio
Over 28 crore women have Jan Dhan bank accounts
Maternal health programmes have cut the maternal mortality rate from 174 to 97
